description.fun: A little squire born when burnt charcoal came to life. Charcadet has a fiery fighting spirit and takes on even opponents tougher than itself, and the longer it fights, the hotter it burns, past 1,000 °C. It's partial to fatty Berries. People have prized its skill with flames since ancient times, and an old suit of armour decides what kind of knight it grows into.
description.guide: A Fire-type Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, designed by Tomohiro Kitakaze, said to be burnt charcoal come to life. It evolves into Armarouge or Ceruledge depending on which armour it is given.
description.tagline: A charcoal squire looking for its suit of armour

branches.text: The armour decides. Auspicious Armor, filled with good wishes and once worn by a distinguished warrior, makes the loyal Fire and Psychic-type Armarouge; Malicious Armor, steeped in a fallen swordsman's grudges, makes the merciless Fire and Ghost-type Ceruledge. The two are mirror images, sharing the same base stats in swapped places.

description.fun: Armarouge evolved by donning armour that once belonged to a distinguished warrior, and that armour, fortified with psychic and fire energy, is the source of its power. It fights fair and head-on, shielding itself first, then joining its pauldrons into an arm cannon that fires blazing fireballs. Fiercely loyal to its Trainer, it still keeps slipping away to train alone.
description.guide: The Fire and Psychic-type evolution of Charcadet given the Auspicious Armor, a knight-like Pokémon that fires blasts from a cannon formed by its armour. It may draw on the Spanish knight Wilfred the Hairy.
description.tagline: A loyal knight in a distinguished warrior's armour

description.fun: Ceruledge evolved inside an old suit of armour steeped in grudges, and the fiery blades on its arms burn with the lingering resentment of a swordsman who fell before reaching their goal. It cuts its enemies down without mercy, and wounds from its blades leak life energy that the swords soak up. Its Ghost type may nod to El Cid, said to have won a battle after his death.
description.guide: The Fire and Ghost-type evolution of Charcadet given the Malicious Armor, a swordsman Pokémon with blades of fire on its arms. It may draw on the Spanish knight El Cid and his two swords.
description.tagline: A ghostly swordsman burning with an old grudge
